spans.view: with a cream sofa at the left and a glass coffee table in front holding a tipped-over mug in a brown spill

beats.text: Polly waddles slowly to the right behind the glass table, eyeing the spilled mug with a worried face
Polly closes her eyes and lets out a sigh as she keeps waddling
Polly turns to the right and hurries off until she is out of view

spans.notes: shot_review called this shot an insert with no lead; Polly is in it. Camera locked (sofa and table edges overlap in compare 0/62 and 87/94). spans.view: with a cream sofa at the left and a glass coffee table in front holding a tipped-over mug in a brown spill

beats.text: The sofa and the glass table with the spilled mug sit empty in the quiet room
Polly waddles back in from the right holding a yellow cloth
Polly leans over the glass table, lifts the tipped mug and wipes up the spill with the yellow cloth
Polly holds the mug up beside the table and smiles while sparkles twinkle on the clean glass

spans.view: with a light switch on the wall, the ceiling light off, and a cream sofa seen through the arch

beats.text: Pax waddles in from the left through the arched doorway and stops
Pax reaches out and flicks the light switch on the wall
Pax lowers his flipper and looks around the dim room, puzzled
Pax flicks the switch again and again with a stern frown

spans.notes: Room is drawn dim (light off), so Pax's belly reads grey; as he enters the doorway light gives him a soft highlight. Wall, switch and bin checked static (phase correlation ~0 px over f95-148); the ORB track's per-frame jumps here were Pax. v4/shot_review suspected a pull-back: it is a fast zoom out at f149-153, dropped below.
fast zoom out (scale 0.80-0.96 per frame) to a wide view of the room

spans.view: with an unlit bulb hanging from the ceiling and a turquoise kitchen counter at the right

beats.text: Pax stands by the light switch and looks up at the unlit ceiling bulb with a flat face
Pax huffs with his beak open, glaring up at the bulb
Pax shuts his eyes and turns away toward the kitchen counter

spans.notes: 23 static frames after the zoom out (f154 equals f155 position; motion stops at f154). Pax is small.

spans.view: with a sink and tap on the counter and the ceiling light off

beats.text: Pax carries a wooden ladder and stands it up against the counter, his back turned
Pax turns around and waddles left to a drawer in the counter
Pax pulls the drawer open and reaches inside
Pax watches as the drawer front breaks off and drops, spilling pliers, screws and a light bulb on the floor
Pax stares at the broken drawer with his beak open in surprise
Pax squeezes his eyes shut and winces
Pax glares at the mess with flat, narrowed eyes
Pax squeezes his eyes shut and flaps a flipper out in frustration
Pax turns and stomps off to the right with a stern frown

spans.notes: Shelf, bottle, jar and tap edges overlap in compare 177/269; the ORB jumps at f178-183 are Pax and the ladder. Room drawn dim.

spans.view: with a wall cabinet above a low cabinet and the ceiling light off

beats.text: Pax waddles in from the left with a stern face and stops beside the kitchen cabinets
Pax reaches up and pulls open the wall cabinet door, which swings out crooked on one hinge
Pax holds the loose cabinet door up and stares at it with a flat, unimpressed look, a drill and red toolbox inside
Pax lets go of the door, shuts his eyes and sighs, then looks up again
Pax reaches up with both flippers to push the cabinet straight
Pax squeezes his eyes shut and grabs his head as the wall cabinet tips forward and the drill, toolbox and a screwdriver slide out at him

spans.notes: Camera locked through the crash: the low cabinet's edges overlap in compare 270/366 and 360/378; only the wall cabinet tilts. Room drawn dim.

spans.view: with a light switch on the wall and a cream sofa seen through the arch

beats.text: Polly waddles in from the left through the doorway and stops in the dim room
Polly reaches a flipper toward the light switch on the wall
Polly stares ahead with wide eyes and her beak open in shock

spans.notes: arch, wall and bin edges overlap in compare 380/400 (ORB jumps were Polly). Room drawn dim, Polly's belly reads grey.

spans.view: with Polly seen from behind, close in the left foreground, and an upturned stool and a red toolbox on the floor by Pax

beats.text: Pax sits on the floor frowning as he works a screwdriver into an upturned wooden stool while Polly stands watching him
Pax looks up at Polly with wide eyes, holding the screwdriver up
Pax gives a nervous little smile as a sweat drop runs down his face

spans.notes: Over-the-shoulder: Polly's back and head fill the left foreground (partial), Pax sits in the middle distance. Counter in the background drawn soft-focus. Counter and toolbox edges overlap in compare 408/482.
18 frames: Polly close, staring in dismay

spans.view: with Polly seen from behind, close in the left foreground, and an upturned stool and a red toolbox on the floor by Pax

beats.text: Pax sits behind the upturned stool holding up a screwdriver with a nervous smile while Polly stands watching
Pax shuts his eyes in a sheepish open-beaked grin, still holding up the screwdriver, while Polly watches
Pax keeps grinning with his eyes shut as a light bulb drops from above toward the floor beside him
Pax opens his eyes wide and throws up a flipper as the bulb shatters beside him, while Polly lifts a flipper
